title: Cookie Security
definition: Cookies can be secured via flags: `HttpOnly` (prevents `document.cookie` access via JS), `Secure` (forces HTTPS transmission), and `SameSite` (prevents cross-origin sending to mitigate CSRF).
simpleExplanation: Adding security locks to your cookies so hackers can't read them via scripts or hijack them during cross-site requests.
